A short film about how expert support reaches people in a crisis

RVO is making a short video about the MHPSS Surge Mechanism, told through one real deployment: Adib Asrori, a clinical psychologist deployed to Nepal at the request of WHO to help organisations coordinate mental health and psychosocial support after the floods.

RVO
Netherlands Enterprise Agency. Manages the MHPSS Surge Mechanism for the Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Expert deployed
Sends mental health and psychosocial experts to organisations in crises. Here: Adib, hosted by WHO in Nepal.
Makmende Media
The production company filming the video for RVO.

What will be made

3-minute film
3 short social media clips
Photographs

Who will see it

  • 1Mental health and psychosocial professionals who may join the expert roster
  • 2Organisations that may request expert support
  • 3Donors who may fund future deployments

Shown on RVO's social media channels and at events and conferences.

What the camera shows

  • Colleagues at work, such as a session around a district map
  • A conversation about practical challenges in the work
  • The setting of a site, without people in view

What is not filmed

  • Affected families
  • Children
  • Residents of the site
  • Counselling or service delivery

Your choice

You may say no. If you prefer not to appear, tell the crew; they will work around you.
You choose per use. Photo, video and interview are separate yes/no choices on the next page.
You may change your mind. Contact Makmende Media or your local contact; material already printed cannot be withdrawn.

This page is additional information to help you decide. It is not part of the Makmende Media form.

RVO MHPSS and Makmende Media are committed to ensuring its communication does not affect people either now or in the future.

Instructions for the crew
  1. Informed consent is the process where a person understands: why an image, video, and/or information is being taken; how it will be used; how long Makmende Media will use it for; to contact production@makmendemedia.com if they change their mind
  2. Always ask permission before you take a picture, video, and/or information of someone
  3. If an image is taken of a child a parent must also sign the form as the parent is the legal guardian. If the child does not have a parent, ask the child’s legal guardian (this could be a family member or a caretaker) to counter sign.
When you sign and submit, the signed form is saved as a PDF on this device, and one copy is sent by email to the coordinators of this video for safekeeping. The page keeps nothing else. You may also send your PDF to the crew (Niranjan) or to production@makmendemedia.com.

Your details

Someone has explained to me that the RVO MHPSS Surge Mechanism is a rapid-response program managed by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) on behalf of the Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It quickly deploys specialized experts in Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) to international humanitarian organizations, UN agencies (like UNICEF, IOM, and UNHCR), and NGOs during crises, natural disasters, or conflict situations

By signing, I understand that the person who is recognizable on the images (moving or still) and in the interview, taken by Makmende Media for RVO MHPSS, that:

  1. all portraits on these images are made with his/her/their explicit authorization;
  2. the copyrights (including portrait rights) and other intellectual property rights concerning these images belong to the photographer and Makmende Media;
  3. Makmende Media will file the images and interview in their archive for 7 years. During this period Makmende Media is allowed to use the images for their portfolio and as stock footage for other Makmende Media projects, while ensuring this does not affect the person depicted;
  4. iImage and interview consent can be changed or withdrawn at any time before by notifying Makmende Media or your local contact. Images and interviews already published in printed versions cannot be withdrawn’
  5. permission will be re-sought after 7 years;
  6. Makmende Media is indemnified against all possible claims concerning those rights;
  7. I am legally and unconditionally bound to this statement.
